rationale: This revised plan addresses the critical feedback from the evaluation. The collect_findings step now includes the complete portfolio of sources: denial analysis (T2), fraud exploration (T5), and both high-cost models (T6, T7), meeting the core sources requirement. The brief_sections step enables full citation coverage by setting cite_artifacts to true, ensuring every numeric statement in the executive brief carries a [source: ...] citation for reproducibility. The sections (key_findings, model_results, limitations, next_steps) and report structure remain appropriate for the executive audience and task requirements.
changes_summary: Sources expanded from [T2, T3, T4, T6] to [T2, T5, T6, T7] to include fraud exploration (T5) and the second high-cost model (T7). Brief citations enabled (cite_artifacts: true) to ensure all numeric statements are traceable to source artifacts or metrics keys, directly addressing the reproducibility gaps identified in the evaluation.
